:::{#def-fitted-model}
#### Fitted model

A **fitted model** $\emodmem$ is a member of a [model family](#def-model-family) $\modelfam$
that has been chosen to describe a [data set](#def-data-set) $\dataset$.
As a member of $\modelfam$, it is a [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/functions.html#def-function)
that maps each [covariate](#def-covariate) value $\predvar$
to a [prediction](prediction.qmd#def-prediction) of the outcome.

:::
